changes.before: Boss Materials — three Boss Stage cards, eight Boss Profile cards, and a dedicated 32-card Boss Arsenal Deck containing Boss Attacks, Boss Defenses, and Boss Techniques for Dojo Drama.
changes.after: Boss Materials — three Boss Stage cards, ten Boss Profile cards, and a dedicated 32-card Boss Arsenal Deck containing Boss Attacks, Boss Defenses, and Boss Techniques for Dojo Drama. The Department counted twice and has filed the first count as a training incident.

changes.before: A fast 1v1 variant with one Character per player. Last Fighter Standing wins; Black Belt Victory is not used. Belt progression and stat rewards still apply.
changes.after: A fast 1v1 variant with one Character per player. Last Fighter Standing wins; Black Belt Victory is not used. Belt Exams, abilities, ATK, DEF, Focus, and hand-size rewards still apply, but promotion never raises Max HP or heals a fighter. Quick Duel keeps the paperwork and removes the medical expansion plan.

changes.before: 5. During Yell, legally play cards one at a time. A normal turn allows two Attacks. One Attack with Flow does not count against that limit. Resolve every Attack and Reaction completely before continuing.

changes.before: 6. Cards legally played or Equipped from hand during your own turn generate their printed Focus. During Ascend, spend Focus on Market cards or one Combo attempt.
changes.after: 6. Cards legally played or Equipped from hand during your own turn generate printed Focus before their effects resolve. Defense Practice generates only the practiced card's printed Focus. During Ascend, spend Focus on Market cards or one Combo attempt.

changes.before: 9. After everyone acts, resolve end-of-round effects, refresh all seven Market slots, pass the referee marker, and begin the next round.
changes.after: 9. After a Market purchase, reveal two Market cards; the buyer chooses one to refill the empty slot and discards the other. After everyone acts, resolve end-of-round effects, refresh all seven Market slots, pass the referee marker, and begin the next round.

changes.before: Every Character begins at 25 HP. Damage reduces current HP. Healing cannot raise a fighter above maximum HP. At 0 HP, the fighter is Knocked Out. Belt rewards increase maximum HP.
changes.after: Every Character begins at 25 HP. Damage reduces current HP. Healing cannot raise a fighter above maximum HP. At 0 HP, the fighter is Knocked Out. Belt rewards increase maximum HP except in Quick Duel, where Max HP remains 25 unless a card or scenario explicitly changes it.

changes.before: Cards played outside your own turn do not generate their printed Focus Value unless their rules text explicitly grants Focus.
changes.after: Cards played outside your own turn do not generate their printed Focus Value unless their rules text explicitly grants Focus. Explicit Focus gained outside your turn remains until your next Hide unless that effect gives it another duration.

changes.before: Focus printed on a card is not a victory value. It is the card's contribution to that turn's purchasing power.
changes.after: Defense Practice is the one core exception: once during your Yell, reveal one Defense from hand and place it in your play area to gain its printed Focus. It is not played, provides no Guard, resolves no rules text, grants no XP, and cannot satisfy a card, Combo, or Belt Exam requirement. Discard it during Hide. The Department calls this studying because 'discarding your guard to buy a helmet' tested poorly.

changes.after: Focus printed on a card is not a victory value. It is the card's contribution to that turn's purchasing power.

changes.before:
FINAL COMBAT FORMULA
Attack Power = Attack card Damage + Character ATK + eligible Weapons + modifiers. Defense = Character DEF + matching Armor + one Defense card + modifiers. Damage = max(0, Attack Power − Defense).
changes.after:
FINAL COMBAT FORMULA
Attack Power = printed Attack Power + Character ATK + eligible Weapons + modifiers. Defense = Character DEF + matching Armor + one Defense card's Guard + modifiers. Damage = max(0, Attack Power − Defense).

changes.before: When a promotion grants +10 Max HP, every Character on that player's roster increases Max HP by 10. Then only the active Character heals 5 HP, up to its new maximum. changes.before: 1. Reveal Boss Arsenal cards until an Attack is revealed. Resolve any Boss Defense or Boss Technique revealed along the way immediately. changes.after: 1. Reveal Boss Arsenal cards until an Attack is revealed. Resolve each Boss Technique immediately, then continue revealing. Place each revealed Boss Defense face up in the Boss Guard area. If another Boss Defense is already there, discard the old one before placing the new Guard.

changes.before: 2. The Boss targets your active Character and attacks the printed zone. If Boss Defense is active for that zone, apply its Guard value to this Attack, then discard it. If the zone does not match, discard Boss Defense without applying it.
changes.after: 2. The Boss targets the instructed active Character and attacks the printed zone. Boss Guard never adds to a Boss Attack; it protects the Boss from a later player Attack.

changes.before: 3. Boss Attack Power = Boss Attack Damage + printed Boss ATK + the current Boss Stage Attack Bonus.

An unmatched player Attack leaves Boss Guard in place. A newly revealed Boss Defense replaces the old one.

changes.before: Do not discard unpurchased Market cards at end of round. Refill purchased spaces normally. If a complete round ends with no Market purchase, discard and refill all seven slots.

changes.before: The forced refresh prevents an unwanted Market from freezing the game.
changes.after: The forced refresh prevents an unwanted Market from freezing the game while preserving the buyer's normal refill choice.

after.title: Boss KO during your Yell Phase
after.ruling: Finish only that player's Ascend and Hide Phases, then transition stages. Remaining players skip their turns for that round.

after.title: Boss KO outside your own Yell Phase
after.ruling: If the KO occurs during a player turn, that player may complete Ascend and Hide. Otherwise, transition immediately.

after.title: Speed comparisons use current Speed
after.ruling: Tempo and other Speed comparisons use current Speed after active modifiers. Printed Speed is the base value.

after.title: Initiative is locked for the round
after.ruling: Honor determines initiative. Later Speed changes and tagging do not reorder turns until the next Honor Phase.

after.title: Player wins a Speed tie with a Boss
after.ruling: When a player and Boss have the same current Speed, the player acts before the Boss.

after.title: Multiple learned Combos may share a finisher
after.ruling: Multiple eligible learned Combos may use the same final card or action. Resolve each payoff separately and obey every printed timing limit.

after.title: Co-op stage victory healing
after.ruling: After a Boss stage victory in two-player co-op, each player heals their active fighter 8 HP.

after.title: Shared Rank team variant
after.ruling: Teammates share XP, Belt, promotion tasks, and rewards. Each player keeps normal individual initiative.
